name: Funds routed via informal agents or cash couriers into conflict areas
description: Funds reach regions with armed groups through informal value transfer, MVTS or cash couriers.
fp: Informal channels are often the only access in fragile regions.

links.name: Funds routed through intermediaries or informal value transfer in conflict zones
links.ctx: Charity uses third-party agents, MVTS or cash couriers to reach recipients where regulated banking is limited, with limited visibility of the final recipient.
links.fp: Banking access is genuinely restricted in some crisis settings.
